tools.description: Get a violation or complaint by UUID, including source status and related copies. A complaint is not a confirmed violation. Coverage and published fines vary by source.

tools.description: Search planning and zoning cases by place, type, status, dates and proposed size. A planning case does not guarantee construction. Sources report data_through. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks

tools.name: get_pipeline_case
tools.description: Get a planning case by UUID with linked decisions and permits. A permit link matches site and time, not proof it was issued under this case; link_method and confidence describe the match. A planning case does not guarantee construction. Coverage varies.

tools.name: search_pipeline_decisions
tools.description: Search council, planning commission and zoning board decisions by place, body, action and meeting date. RECOMMENDED_* is a recommendation, not a final decision. A decision does not guarantee construction. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists.

tools.name: search_certificates

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Get an occupancy or completion certificate by UUID, including certificate_status and co_date_basis. A duplicate id resolves to its canonical record. Coverage varies; a completion certificate does not establish occupancy.

tools.name: lookup_license
tools.description: Look up a license number in its issuing state across the public board rosters held, with matching contractors. Coverage and as_of dates vary by board. Access and locked_fields identify unavailable fields; a registration is not a license. No contact enrichment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_permits · Private data: get_property_history, search_inspections, get_permit_inspections, search_violations, search_pipeline_cases, search_pipeline_decisions, search_certificates, get_certificate, lookup_license, get_contractor_licenses · Public sink: search_permits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_permits · Private data: get_property_history, search_inspections, get_permit_inspections, search_violations, search_pipeline_cases, search_pipeline_decisions, search_certificates, get_certificate, lookup_license, get_contractor_licenses · Public sink: search_permits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
